archive_protocol: Create one fixed new sibling archive root0700 on the same filesystem; refuse a foreign destination.
Keep transaction.lock at its original pathname and inode, holding flock throughout.
Move initial.json and adoption-started.json without editing their bytes.
Move the entire snapshot directory by rename, including paired-state.tar, paired-state.json and candidate-state-retained; do not traverse, read, export, extract or modify its contents.
Move any specifically bound incident/reopening metadata intact; reject unknown entries instead of deleting them.
Fsync both source and archive directories after every move.
Move the durable terminal phase.json last: before this commit point a new deploy refuses the old phase.
After the final fsync, the active directory contains only its original transaction.lock; record closed archive-completion metadata outside it.
A killed partial archive remains conservatively blocked by the old phase; resume only under the exact fixed archive binding and same lock, never by generic cleanup.
next_attempt: Use a new sealed controller/release containing the qualified actual-failure correction; no retry of unchanged failing code.
Use a distinct fixed transient unit and result directory; preserve the failed first service and result.
Run the full ordinary preflight, including reserved identity checks, current generation, closure, credentials, source bundles and capacity.
Take a fresh snapshot of the now-current old system; never reuse the historical archived snapshot as a new rollback point.
nonnegotiable: No snapshot restore, extraction, replayed adoption, SQL operation or application-data rewrite.
Never coerce HELD to RETURNING or invoke generic recover on a state after durable RETURNED.
Reopening may publish a separate incident record preserving original HELD then a corrective terminal RETURNED only under the fixed independently reviewed helper and observation binding.
Preserve the guard and use terminal-state selective masks; prevent direct accidental ACME/backups/bootstrap oneshot execution.
retry_archive_preconditions: Separately qualified reopening succeeded; actual previous generation and previous boot profile match.
Application HTTP continuity has been verified and the ingress gate is open.
No live original deploy/recover/reopen process or foreign live lease; acquire the existing transaction.lock exclusively without replacement.
Old metadata bindings exactly match the failed release and incident; expected top-level inventory only.
Owned masks/portable guard must be retired through the reviewed completion path; preserve foreign masks.
scope: Independent retry/archive contract after observed RETURNED followed by HELD; no operational archive or production access.
